title: 0030. Critical-review document merge and Codex-based mock-exam route
summary: Merges the critical summary and summary editions into one document, deletes the figure atlas, scales mock-exam question count per unit, and generates exams via the Codex CLI.
notes: Status is Accepted but partially superseded: dual-route reachability superseded by ADR 0038; the mock-exam source amended by ADR 0045 (reads 09_validated_units instead of 08_drafts). Status field kept as Accepted, so locked is true.
